source.name: Wikidata (CC0)
source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?countryLabel WHERE { { SELECT ?item (SAMPLE(?c) AS ?country) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?nC) (MIN(?d) AS ?inc) WHERE { ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q2977 ; wdt:P571 ?d ; wdt:P17 ?c ; wikibase:sitelinks ?sl . FILTER(?sl >= 8) } GROUP BY ?item } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . FILTER(?nC = 1) FILTER(YEAR(?inc) >= 500 && YEAR(?inc) < 1520) OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,mul". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 160

country.match: Match each medieval church to its country.
country.odd: Three of these medieval churches are in {value}. Which one isn't?

rows.label: Cologne Cathedral
rows.description: Roman-Catholic cathedral in Cologne, Germany
rows.hook: is a twin-spired Gothic giant that took centuries to finish and survived heavy bombing in World War II

rows.label: Notre-Dame de Paris
rows.description: cathedral in Paris
rows.hook: is a Gothic landmark on an island in the Seine, famed for its gargoyles and a devastating fire

rows.label: Westminster Abbey
rows.description: Gothic abbey church in London, England, UK
rows.hook: is a Gothic church beside the Thames where monarchs are crowned and many are buried

rows.label: Florence Cathedral
rows.description: 13th-century cathedral in Florence, Italy
rows.hook: is topped by a huge red-tiled dome designed by Brunelleschi

rows.label: Milan Cathedral
rows.description: cathedral church of Milan, Italy
rows.hook: is a marble Gothic giant with a forest of spires and thousands of statues

rows.label: Mosque-Cathedral of Cordoba
rows.description: cathedral (former mosque) in Cordoba, Spain
rows.hook: is a former Islamic house of worship with a forest of red-and-white striped arches

rows.label: Lincoln Cathedral
rows.description: cathedral located in Lincoln in England
rows.hook: was once the tallest building in the world, thanks to a spire that later collapsed

rows.label: Canterbury Cathedral
rows.description: cathedral in Canterbury, Kent, England, founded in 597
rows.hook: is the seat of the head of the Church of England and the site of Thomas Becket's murder

rows.label: Salisbury Cathedral
rows.description: church of England cathedral in Salisbury, England, UK
rows.hook: has the tallest church spire in England and houses a famous original copy of the Magna Carta

rows.label: York Minster
rows.description: cathedral of York, North Yorkshire, England, UK
rows.hook: is one of the largest Gothic buildings in northern Europe, known for its huge medieval stained glass

rows.label: St. Stephen's Cathedral
rows.description: church in Vienna, Austria
rows.hook: is a Gothic landmark with a colorful patterned tile roof and a towering south spire

rows.label: St Mark's Basilica
rows.description: church in Venice, Italy
rows.hook: is a Byzantine-style church with golden mosaics and four bronze horses, beside the Doge's Palace

rows.label: Nidaros Cathedral
rows.description: cathedral in Trondheim, Norway
rows.hook: is the northernmost medieval church of its kind and the burial place of a Viking king turned saint

rows.label: Basilica of Saint-Denis
rows.description: basilica located in Seine-Saint-Denis, in France
rows.hook: is often called the birthplace of Gothic architecture and holds the tombs of French kings

rows.label: Cathedral of Our Lady of Strasbourg
rows.description: cathedral located in Bas-Rhin, in France
rows.hook: has a single soaring spire and was the world's tallest building for over two centuries

rows.label: Seville Cathedral
rows.description: Catholic Cathedral in Seville (Formerly a Mosque), Spain
rows.hook: is the largest Gothic church in the world and holds the tomb of Christopher Columbus

rows.label: Notre-Dame de Chartres
rows.description: medieval Catholic cathedral in Chartres, France
rows.hook: is renowned for its medieval stained glass and a labyrinth set into the floor

rows.label: Winchester Cathedral
rows.description: cathedral in Winchester, Hampshire, England, UK
rows.hook: has one of the longest naves in Europe and is the resting place of novelist Jane Austen

rows.label: Reims Cathedral
rows.description: Roman Catholic cathedral of Reims in France
rows.hook: is where nearly every French king was crowned, including after Joan of Arc's campaign

rows.label: Bayeux Cathedral
rows.description: cathedral located in Calvados, in France
rows.hook: is a Norman-Gothic landmark in the town famous for a long embroidered tapestry

rows.label: Rouen Cathedral
rows.description: cathedral located in Seine-Maritime, in France
rows.hook: was painted many times at different hours of the day by Claude Monet
